candidate_score_agreement.definition: number of chunk IDs with identical integer score divided by 50

kendall_tau_b.definition: Kendall tau-b between per-chunk integer score vectors, retaining score ties

ranking_position_agreement.definition: number of identical chunk IDs at identical deterministic rank positions divided by 50

spearman_rho.definition: Spearman correlation between deterministic rank positions for all 50 chunk IDs

top_10_overlap.definition: size of intersection between primary and replicate top-10 sets divided by 10

execution_order.first_valid_execution_role: primary; same result used in 34-query primary run

interpretation: Thresholds are preregistered pilot validity gates, not universal reproducibility standards. Failure blocks full execution and metrics; it does not permit prompt/model tuning.
model_version_rule: First valid trace response establishes returned modelVersion. Every trace replicate and later full-run response must match exactly or run aborts.
